description:
# Compliance ticket for opi-q5k.19

Source check: opi-q5k.19 (truncated-text.test.ts audit)

## Implementation

Add `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/truncated_text.ex` matching upstream `tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/components/truncated-text.ts`:

    TruncatedText struct:
      text :: String.t()
      padding_x :: non_neg_integer() (default 0)
      padding_y :: non_neg_integer() (default 0)

    TruncatedText.render(truncated_text, width) :: [String.t()]

Semantics:
- Uses only the first line of `text` (stops at `\n`) — subsequent lines discarded.
- Available width for content = `width - 2 * padding_x` (when paddingX > 0, subtract from both sides).
- Content line is truncated with an ellipsis `"..."` when it exceeds available width; truncation uses the shared `WrapAnsi.truncate_to_width/4` from opi-q5k.31 (depend on that work being in place, or coordinate merge order).
- Reset code `\e[0m` inserted before the ellipsis when styled text is cut.
- Content line is padded (with spaces) so the total `visible_width(line) == width`.
- `padding_y` lines of blank (but width-padded) lines are prepended AND appended (e.g., padding_y=2 → 2 above + 1 content + 2 below = 5 lines).

## Dependencies
- Blocks: opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate)
- Soft-depends on opi-q5k.31 (WrapAnsi.truncate_to_width) — coordinate so that opi-q5k.31 lands first, or share a branch.

## Tests to port to new `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/truncated_text_test.exs`

1. `TruncatedText{text: "Hello world", padding_x: 1, padding_y: 0}` rendered at width 50 → 1 line of visible_width 50.
2. `padding_x: 0, padding_y: 2` rendered at width 40 → 5 lines, each visible_width 40.
3. Long text ("This is a very long piece of text that will definitely exceed the available width") rendered at width 30 with padding_x 1 → 1 line, visible_width 30, stripped contains "...".
4. Styled text (red "Hello" + blue "world") rendered at width 40 → 1 line, visible_width 40, contains an ANSI escape.
5. Long styled text (red "This is a very long red text...") rendered at width 20 → 1 line, visible_width 20, contains `"\e[0m..."` preceding the ellipsis.
6. "Hello world" at width 30 → 1 line, visible_width 30, no "..." in stripped.
7. Empty text at width 30 → 1 line, visible_width 30.
8. Multiline "First line\\nSecond line\\nThird line" at width 40 → 1 line containing "First line", NOT containing "Second line"/"Third line".
9. Multiline long first line ("This is a very long first line that needs truncation\\nSecond line") at width 25 → 1 line, visible_width 25, contains "...", does NOT contain "Second line".

## Re-comparison (required)

After implementation + tests land, re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/truncated-text.test.ts and confirm every `it(...)` has an Elixir equivalent. Post a final comment here before closing.

## Notes

The coding-agent layer (apps/octo_pi_coding_agent or equivalent — grep) may benefit from adopting TruncatedText for its interactive status/footer lines later. Out of scope for this ticket.
title: Implement Components.TruncatedText + port truncated-text.test.ts (9 tests)
